# Priest Acolyte (`monsters:priest-acolyte`)
*Medium or small humanoid, neutral* | **CR** 1/4 (XP 50; PB +2)
**AC** 13 ([Chain Shirt](../equipment/chain-shirt.md)) | **HP** 11 (2d8 + 2) | **Speed** 30 ft.
**STR** 14 (+2) | **DEX** 10 (+0) | **CON** 12 (+1) | **INT** 10 (+0) | **WIS** 14 (+2) | **CHA** 11 (+0)
**Skills:** [Skill: Medicine](../proficiencies/skill-medicine.md) +4, [Skill: Religion](../proficiencies/skill-religion.md) +2
**Senses:** Passive Perception 12
**Languages:** Common
**Gear:** Chain Shirt, Holy Symbol, Mace

## Actions
- **Mace.** Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Bludgeoning damage plus 2 (1d4) Radiant damage.
- **Radiant Flame.** Ranged Attack Roll: +4, range 60 ft. Hit: 7 (2d6) Radiant damage.
- **Spellcasting.** The priest casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability:
  - At will: [Light](../spells/light.md), [Thaumaturgy](../spells/thaumaturgy.md)

## Bonus Actions
- **Divine Aid (1/day).** The priest casts Bless, Healing Word, or Sanctuary, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.
  - Other: [Bless](../spells/bless.md) (level 1), [Healing Word](../spells/healing-word.md) (level 1), [Sanctuary](../spells/sanctuary.md) (level 1)
